name: Waiting To Speak
overview: Scripture teaches the wisdom and necessity of waiting to speak, emphasizing self-control and thoughtful speech. The believer is called to guard their words carefully, as seen in Psalms 141:3 where the psalmist asks the Lord to watch over the mouth and guard the lips. Proverbs highlights that restraint in speech preserves life and reflects understanding, while excessive talking often leads to sin and destruction. Job models a teachable spirit, willing to hold his tongue to receive correction, demonstrating that waiting to speak is rooted in humility and a desire for godly wisdom.
